translation: Warm, non-toxic. It treats inferior qi, unilateral cold in the flesh, and insufficiency of qi; it resolves poison, kills ghosts, essence-things, warm malaria [溫瘧] and gu poison [蠱毒], and conducts the medicines. Taken over a long time, it lightens the body and reaches the spirit immortals. One name is Mixiang [蜜香].
